message.abstract: <jats:p>We expose in full detail a constructive procedure to invert the so-called ‘finite Markov moment problem’. The proofs rely on the general theory of Toeplitz matrices together with the classical Newton's relations.</jats:p>
title: Resolution of the finite Markov moment problem⁎⁎Support by the Wolfgang Pauli Institute (Wien) in the framework of the “Nanoscience” Programme and the European network HYKE, funded by the EC as contract HPRN-CT-2002-00282 is acknowledged.
